name: bosun
description: Spec-anchored workflow for autonomous coding runs on Claude Fable 5.1: brief, run, verify, checkpoint, with a fable-crew provider mode that routes implementation to gpt-5.6-sol or gpt-5.6-luna. The fable-opus mode uses an Opus implementer with a Fable lead; opus uses Opus in every role. Claude verifier effort is independently selectable. A sibling Codex plugin in codex/ runs the same spec on GPT-6 Astra. Built from Anthropic's Fable 5.1 docs.
